mentions.name: Single-page Neovim todo list setup
mentions.description: This setup manages a personal todo list in Neovim, replacing Obsidian, with the goal of keeping everything on a single page since a todo list benefits more from simplicity than power.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm learning Neovim to manage my todolist (replacing Obsidian). My goal is to just keep it at a single page, since instead of having power, a todo list really benefits from simplicity.

evidence.value: I'm learning Neovim to manage my todolist (replacing Obsidian). My goal is to just keep it at a single page, since instead of having power, a todo list really benefits from simplicity.
